references.text: Aaron took Elisheba, daughter of Amminadab and sister of Nahshon, as his wife. She bore him Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. The same four sons of Aaron are mentioned here.
Aaron and his sons Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar were called to the priestly service. The same four sons are mentioned.
Nadab and Abihu offered unauthorized fire before the Lord and died. This explains why the two eldest sons did not continue in the priestly service.
Aaron had sons named Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Nadab and Abihu died when they offered unauthorized fire before the Lord. This confirms the lineage and fate of the two eldest.
The sons of Aaron: Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. The genealogy in Chronicles confirms these four sons.
Aaron's sons were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar. Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no sons, so Eleazar and Ithamar served as priests.
